items.summary: MONAI's TensorRT export/compile path (monai/networks/trt_compiler.py, convert_to_trt/trt_compile in monai/networks/utils.py) is NVIDIA-only and inert on ROCm (tests skip). A ROCm equivalent would be a new MIGraphX/torch_migraphx backend that neither upstream nor AMD-Ecosystem/MONAI amd-develop has. Planner recommends defer; Jeff rules defer vs now before MONAI is marked planned.

MONAI's GPU DICOM decoder (NvImgCodecPydicomReader, monai/data/nvimgcodec_pydicom_plugin.py, the monai[nvimgcodec] extra) delegates to NVIDIA's nvidia.nvimgcodec pydicom plugin plus CuPy and is inert on ROCm, falling back to pydicom/ITK CPU decoding. The ROCm counterpart covers only part: rocJPEG (Python via rocPyDecode's rocPyJpegDecode, a Linux system package) decodes baseline JPEG; there is no ROCm GPU decoder for JPEG Lossless, JPEG 2000 or HTJ2K. A ROCm reader would be a new rocJPEG-backed pydicom decoder plugin in MONAI. Planner recommends defer (consistent with the TensorRT ruling); Jeff rules defer vs now before MONAI is marked planned.

MONAI's GPUDirect Storage paths (GDSDataset in monai/data/dataset.py, the to_gpu option of the image readers in monai/data/image_reader.py) use RAPIDS kvikio, which has no ROCm build, so they are inert on ROCm and their tests skip. The ROCm GDS library is hipFile, reachable from PyTorch through torch.cuda.gds (hipFile-backed on ROCm). Options: defer; port kvikio itself as a separate MOAT project (an intake request); or give MONAI a torch.cuda.gds backend. Planner recommends defer; Jeff rules before MONAI is marked planned.
